title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Aventador SVJ
description:
The Lamborghini Aventador SVJ has a rear wing that is designed to stall on purpose, and a production count that two sources cannot agree on. It also set a Nürburgring record that is quoted three slightly different ways. Two things most people do not know about the Aventador SVJ, with every figure sourced and every disagreement shown. Our sources are Wikipedia's Aventador and Huracán pages, an IEEE Spectrum review, an Autocar road test republished by Yahoo, Auto Bild from September twenty eighteen, and the cost pages we flag as weaker. They disagree on weight, price, power and production. We show each version. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:51 Thing one: the wing that stalls on purpose
4:18 The lap
6:33 Thing two: the numbers nobody agrees on
9:50 Prices and production
12:07 Where it sits in the story
14:35 After the SVJ
18:55 The engine and the acceleration, in numbers
21:38 What the sources do not say

Sources:
- Wikipedia, Lamborghini Aventador: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamborghini_Aventador
- Wikipedia, Lamborghini Huracán: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamborghini_Hurac%C3%A1n
- IEEE Spectrum, 2019's Top 10 Tech Cars: Lamborghini Aventador SVJ: https://spectrum.ieee.org/2019s-top-10-tech-cars-lamborghini-aventador-svj
- Autocar (Richard Lane), Lamborghini Aventador SVJ road test, via Yahoo Autos: https://autos.yahoo.com/lamborghini-aventador-svj-124100598.html
- Auto Bild, Lamborghini Aventador SVJ 2018: alle Infos, 19 Sep 2018: https://www.autobild.de/artikel/lamborghini-aventador-svj-2018-alle-infos-13496177.html
- Automonitor.io, What does an Aventador SVJ actually cost to own? (unsourced estimates): https://automonitor.io/blog/how-much-does-a-lamborghini-aventador-svj-cost/
